title: Create & manage posts on your Business Profile - Google Business Profile Help

facts.fact: Google states that the featured posts feature is currently available in English for single-location food and drink businesses in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand.
facts.quote: This feature is currently available in English for single-location food and drink businesses in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand.

facts.fact: Google states that posts older than 6 months are archived unless a date range is set.
facts.quote: Posts older than 6 months are archived unless a date range is set.

facts.fact: Google states that if an event has no start or end time, the event shows as lasting 24 hours on the event dates.
facts.quote: If you don’t provide a start or end time, the event shows as lasting 24 hours on the event dates.

facts.fact: Google states that Offer posts require a title, dates, and time, and automatically include a "View Offer" button.
facts.quote: It requires a title, dates, and time. This automatically includes a "View Offer" button on the post.

facts.fact: Google states that posts including a phone number in the description might be rejected if the number cannot be verified as connected to the business on which they are posted.
facts.quote: Posts that include a phone number in the post description might get rejected if they cannot be verified as being connected to the business on which they are posted.

facts.fact: Google states that when featured posts are available, customers find them in place of reviews on the Business Profile on mobile, though reviews remain accessible via the star rating or the Reviews tab.
facts.quote: When featured posts are available, customers find them in place of reviews on your Business Profile on mobile.

facts.fact: Google defines a post status of Live as public and showing on Search and Maps, Pending as not showing because it is in upload or processing or the profile is unverified, and Not approved as not showing due to a content policy violation.
facts.quote: **Pending:** The post doesn't show on Search or Maps. It’s either in the upload stage, the processing stage, or your profile is unverified.

facts.fact: Google states that the Update post type can include a description, photo, video, and an action button with a link.
facts.quote: You can add a description, photo, video, and an action button with a link.
